task_description: Build the PMR3407 Pneumatic Circuit Generator: a deterministic (non-LLM-at-runtime) generator of pneumatic and electropneumatic circuits based on the PMR3407 course methods. Deliver docs/PMR3407_RULES.md, a full Kiro Spec (requirements/design/tasks), a zero-dependency TypeScript core with clean pipeline separation (parser -> sequence model -> method solver -> logical circuit -> validator -> layout -> SVG renderer -> simulator), golden + property-based tests, and prioritize the FIRST MILESTONE (Electropneumatic + Step-by-step) end to end with tests green. Cascade and the presentation/UI layer follow. Network is INTEGRATIONS_ONLY so the core has no npm dependencies (Node v22 native TS + node --test); React/Vite UI is best-effort and documented.
